fields.Name: UI: Work Reports - Author or Supervisor Chain
fields.Description: Restricts Work Report reads and updates to the report author, anyone up the author's reporting chain at arbitrary depth via __mj_BizAppsCommon.vwPersonReportingChain, or administrative roles (Owner, System Administrator, Administrator, Admin, Administration).
fields.FilterText: (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommon].[Person] callerP WHERE (callerP.[LinkedUserID] = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj].[User] callerU WHERE callerU.[ID] = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND (TRY_CAST(callerU.[LinkedEntityRecordID] AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) = callerP.[ID] OR (callerP.[LinkedUserID] IS NULL AND callerP.[Email] IS NOT NULL AND callerU.[Email] IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(callerP.[Email]) = LOWER(callerU.[Email]))))) AND (callerP.[ID] = [PersonID] OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommon].[vwPersonReportingChain] rc WHERE rc.[PersonID] = [PersonID] AND rc.[SupervisorPersonID] = callerP.[ID]))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj].[User] u LEFT JOIN [__mj].[UserRole] ur ON ur.[UserID] = u.[ID] LEFT JOIN [__mj].[Role] r ON r.[ID] = ur.[RoleID] WHERE u.[ID] = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(u.[Type])) = N'Owner' OR r.[Name] IN (N'System Administrator', N'Administrator', N'Admin', N'Administration'))))

fields.Name: UI: Work Report Items - Author or Supervisor Chain
fields.Description: Restricts Work Report Item reads to items whose parent Work Report belongs to the author, anyone up their reporting chain via vwPersonReportingChain, or an administrative role.
fields.FilterText: ([WorkReportID] IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[WorkReport] wr WHERE wr.[ID] = [WorkReportID] AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommon].[Person] callerP WHERE (callerP.[LinkedUserID] = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj].[User] callerU WHERE callerU.[ID] = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND (TRY_CAST(callerU.[LinkedEntityRecordID] AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) = callerP.[ID] OR (callerP.[LinkedUserID] IS NULL AND callerP.[Email] IS NOT NULL AND callerU.[Email] IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(callerP.[Email]) = LOWER(callerU.[Email]))))) AND (callerP.[ID] = wr.[PersonID] OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommon].[vwPersonReportingChain] rc WHERE rc.[PersonID] = wr.[PersonID] AND rc.[SupervisorPersonID] = callerP.[ID]))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj].[User] u LEFT JOIN [__mj].[UserRole] ur ON ur.[UserID] = u.[ID] LEFT JOIN [__mj].[Role] r ON r.[ID] = ur.[RoleID] WHERE u.[ID] = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(u.[Type])) = N'Owner' OR r.[Name] IN (N'System Administrator', N'Administrator', N'Admin', N'Administration'))))))

fields.Name: UI: Work Report Items - Draft Author Only
fields.Description: Restricts Work Report Item creates and updates to items whose parent Work Report is in Draft status and authored by the signed-in user (or an administrative role).
fields.FilterText: ([WorkReportID] IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[WorkReport] wr WHERE wr.[ID] = [WorkReportID] AND ((wr.[Status] = N'Draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommon].[Person] callerP WHERE callerP.[ID] = wr.[PersonID] AND (callerP.[LinkedUserID] = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj].[User] callerU WHERE callerU.[ID] = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND (TRY_CAST(callerU.[LinkedEntityRecordID] AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) = callerP.[ID] OR (callerP.[LinkedUserID] IS NULL AND callerP.[Email] IS NOT NULL AND callerU.[Email] IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(callerP.[Email]) = LOWER(callerU.[Email]))))))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj].[User] u LEFT JOIN [__mj].[UserRole] ur ON ur.[UserID] = u.[ID] LEFT JOIN [__mj].[Role] r ON r.[ID] = ur.[RoleID] WHERE u.[ID] = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(u.[Type])) = N'Owner' OR r.[Name] IN (N'System Administrator', N'Administrator', N'Admin', N'Administration'))))))
